How to read this map

Paths show documented or proposed relationships. Width is uniform and does not represent volume, importance, value, certainty, or remaining opportunity. Dashed paths identify incomplete, unassessed, or hypothetical evidence. The 2015–2026 span is expanded, so horizontal distance is not proportional across the focus boundary; collision-avoidance rows within a branch do not imply rank.
